spec_features.spec_quote: Instant induction: One event with severity >= instant_induction_severity (default 3, i.e., SEVERE). This catches dramatic collapses early.
spec_features.evidence: ThresholdEvaluator.evaluate (thresholds.py:55-63) only sets summary['triggered']=True when max_severity >= instant_induction_severity. It is called in runner.py:_run_single ONLY AFTER loop.run(task) has fully completed (runner.py: result=loop.run(task); then judge; then threshold_evaluator.evaluate). The tool loop (tool_loop.py) contains no judge/threshold/break wiring (grep shows only the submit_solution break at 452). So this never halts the loop early or changes the subject's treatment; it merely labels a finished run induction_triggered. Value is computed and recorded but never acted on as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Pure post-hoc detection/flagging, not a hard stop. Does not catch or end collapses 'early' in execution; the model is still driven for all max_turns regardless of severity.
